contradictions.a: οἱ κλάδους αὐξηθέντας ἐπὶ πήχεις καὶ δώδεκα · ἔπειτα τὴν λοιπὴν αὔξησιν κατωφερῆ λαμβάνειν
contradictions.b: hōn hoi kladoi anō phuontai epi dōdeka pēcheis, epeita tēn loipēn auxēsin katō pherontai
contradictions.why: A says the branches grow to 12 cubits then turn down; B says they grow upwards for 12 cubits.

omissions.a: Τοῦτο μὲν οὖν εὖ· οὐκέτι δὲ καὶ τὸ μέλανας εἶναι καὶ οὐλότριχας τοὺς Αἰθίοπας, ἐν ψιλοῖς τοῖς ὕδασιν τὴν αἰτίαν τι- (the end of fragment 17 in A is missing the critique of Onesicritus regarding the sun and Theodectes found in B).

additions.b: kai oneidizei Theodektēi tēn aitian eis ton hēlion auton anapemptonti, kathaper ekeinos ho syngrapheus phēsi: kai toi Onesikritos an echoi tina logon; phēsi gar ton hēlion mē mallon engys einai tois Aithiōsin ē tois allois, alla mallon kata katheton kai dia touto mallon kaiein. houtō de phēsi mē kalōs eirēsthai ton hēlion "synorizein" autois, epeidē ison diastēma pantōn estin. epicheirei de kai hoti hē thermotēs ouk estin aition toioutou pathous, epeidē ouch houtōs echei tois en tēi nēdyi, hous ouch haptetai ho hēlios.
